fieldValues.title: Extensions regrouped, governance last
fieldValues.summary: Ground found the invariants-dissolution, governance-finalisation and allowlist-emptying scope items already complete (srs#564 and subsequent units). Remaining scope narrowed to: extension_depends (free text) retires in favor of a depends-on edge; two new Fields state what an extension adds and what not adopting it costs; a hand-authored duplicate declaration table retires in favor of a generated index. Drafted as RFC-042 Revision 4 (not a standalone RFC), stopped at PR per dispatch scope.
